info.title: DevOps Operations API
info.description: API for DevOps operations including infrastructure monitoring, DynamoDB metrics, and deployment management

get.description: Retrieves current status of AWS infrastructure including Auto Scaling Group (ASG), Application Load Balancer (ALB), Target Group, instance refresh status, and recent scaling activities. Use this to check infrastructure health, verify deployments, or troubleshoot issues.

parameters.name: asg_name
parameters.description: Auto Scaling Group name. If not provided, uses default from environment.

parameters.name: include_scaling_activities
parameters.description: Whether to include recent scaling activities in the response

200.description: Infrastructure snapshot with ASG, ALB, Target Group status

get.description: Runs a CloudWatch Logs Insights query across one or more log groups to help with incident RCA (e.g., finding exceptions around 5xx windows).

parameters.name: log_group_names
parameters.description: Comma-separated CloudWatch log group names to query. IMPORTANT: omit this parameter to use Lambda default log groups from OPS_LOG_GROUPS (do NOT pass the literal string 'OPS_LOG_GROUPS').

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: CloudWatch Logs Insights query string (pipe syntax). If omitted, Lambda uses a safe default that filters ERROR/Exception/Traceback/5xx.

get.description: Fetches CloudWatch metrics for ALB and Target Group (5xx counts, request count, latency, healthy/unhealthy hosts) for a recent time window.
Lists CloudWatch alarms and their current state (ALARM/OK/INSUFFICIENT_DATA). Critical for incident detection and monitoring system health. Use this to check if any alarms are firing.

parameters.name: alarm_name_prefix
parameters.description: Filter alarms by name prefix (e.g., 'course-management'). If omitted, returns all alarms.

parameters.name: state_filter
parameters.description: Filter by alarm state: ALARM, OK, or INSUFFICIENT_DATA. If omitted, returns all states.

200.description: List of alarms with their current state

get.summary: Get comprehensive baseline check of entire system
get.description: One-stop tool for baseline system health check. Internally calls get_infrastructure_snapshot, get_cloudwatch_alarms, get_infra_metrics, and get_dynamodb_metrics, then aggregates results. Use this when user asks for 'baseline check toàn bộ hệ thống' or 'full system status'. Returns overall_health status and issues list.

parameters.name: minutes
parameters.description: Time window in minutes for metrics (default 15)

200.description: Aggregated baseline check with infrastructure, alarms, metrics, and DynamoDB status

get.summary: Plan ASG instance refresh with validation (dry run)
get.description: Creates a plan for ASG instance refresh with REAL validation: checks current ASG state, ongoing refreshes, healthy instance count, and calculates impact/risks. Safe to call - does not make any changes. Returns validation results and risk assessment.

parameters.name: min_healthy_percentage
parameters.description: Minimum percentage of healthy instances to maintain during refresh

parameters.name: instance_warmup
parameters.description: Seconds to wait after instance launch before considering it healthy

post.description: Starts an ASG instance refresh (rolling deployment). WARNING: This will terminate and replace instances. Use plan_instance_refresh first to preview. Only call when user explicitly confirms they want to execute.

parameters.name: min_healthy_percentage
parameters.description: Minimum percentage of healthy instances to maintain

parameters.name: instance_warmup
parameters.description: Seconds to wait after instance launch

get.summary: Phân tích nguyên nhân lỗi 5xx (Smart RCA)
get.description: TÌM VÀ PHÂN TÍCH TỰ ĐỘNG nguyên nhân lỗi 5xx. Đây là tool THÔNG MINH nhất - tự động: (1) Tìm lỗi 5xx gần nhất, (2) Giải thích ý nghĩa mã lỗi, (3) Kiểm tra trạng thái infrastructure (ASG, Target Group), (4) Xác định nguyên nhân cụ thể, (5) Đề xuất cách khắc phục. Dùng khi user hỏi: 'Tại sao có lỗi 500/502/503/504?', 'Phân tích lỗi 5xx', 'Nguyên nhân lỗi server?', 'RCA lỗi 5xx'.

parameters.name: minutes
parameters.description: Khoảng thời gian tìm kiếm (phút). Mặc định 60 phút.

parameters.name: include_infra_check
parameters.description: Có kiểm tra infrastructure (ASG, Target Group) không. Mặc định true.

200.description: Kết quả phân tích RCA bao gồm: error_details, root_cause_analysis, infrastructure_state, recommendations, summary

error_details.description: Chi tiết lỗi: timestamp, status_code, method, path, latency_ms

root_cause_analysis.description: Phân tích nguyên nhân: error_type, explanation, likely_cause, source, severity

infrastructure_state.description: Trạng thái infrastructure: ASG health, Target Group health, instance refresh

recommendations.description: Danh sách các bước khắc phục được đề xuất

summary.description: Tóm tắt RCA bằng tiếng Việt
